# Packages 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

# Data 
```{r}
okomeng <- read_csv(here("data", "fall", "exam_04", "okomeng.csv"))
wood <- read_csv(here("data", "fall", "exam_04", "wood.csv"))
baber <- read_csv(here("data", "fall", "exam_04", "baber.csv"))
```

# Reshape the Data & Loop Over all Dataframes 
```{r}
reshape_section <- function(df) {
  df <- df |> 
    group_by(id) |> 
    slice_max(attempt, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
    ungroup()
  
  all_names <- names(df)
  q_positions <- which(str_detect(all_names, "^\\d+:"))
  pts_positions <- q_positions + 1

  pairs <- tibble(
    question_raw = all_names[q_positions],
    points_col = all_names[pts_positions],
    question_id  = str_extract(question_raw, "^\\d+")
  )

  pairs |>
    pmap_dfr(function(question_raw, points_col, question_id) {
      df |>
        mutate(
          question_id = question_id,
          question_title = str_remove(question_raw, "^\\d+:\\s*"),
          selection = as.character(.data[[question_raw]]),
          points = as.numeric(.data[[points_col]]), 
          answered = !is.na(selection) | !is.na(points),
          correct = if_else(!is.na(points) & points == 1.0, 1L, 0L)
        ) |> 
        select(id, section_id, submitted, attempt, question_id,
               question_title, selection, points, answered, correct, score)
    }) 
}

# loop reshape function over all dfs
sections <- list(
  okomeng = okomeng,
  wood = wood,
  baber = baber
)

long <- imap_dfr(
  sections, ~ reshape_section(.x) |> 
    mutate(section = .y)
  )
```

# Analysis 
```{r}
## Item Statistics ----
long <- long |> 
  select(-question_id) |> 
  mutate(
    tier = case_when(
      score >= quantile(score, 2/3, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "top",
      score >= quantile(score, 1/3, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "middle",
      TRUE ~ "bottom"
    )
  )

item_stats <- long |>
  filter(answered) |>
  group_by(question_title) |>
  summarise(
    answered_student_count = n(),
    top_student_count = sum(tier == "top"),
    middle_student_count = sum(tier == "middle"),
    bottom_student_count = sum(tier == "bottom"),
    correct_student_count = sum(correct),
    wrong_student_count = answered_student_count - correct_student_count,
    correct_student_ratio = correct_student_count / answered_student_count,
    wrong_student_ratio = wrong_student_count / answered_student_count,
    correct_top_count = sum(correct == 1 & tier == "top"),
    correct_middle_count = sum(correct == 1 & tier == "middle"),
    correct_bottom_count = sum(correct == 1 & tier == "bottom"),
    difficulty_index = correct_student_ratio,
    variance = difficulty_index * (1 - difficulty_index),
    standard_deviation = sqrt(variance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Discrimination Statistics ----
### Point-biserial ---- 
options_per_q <- long |>
  filter(answered, !is.na(selection)) |>
  distinct(question_title, option = selection)

# every student crossed with every option their item offered
option_pbis <- long |>
  filter(answered, !is.na(selection)) |>
  select(question_title, id, score, selection, correct) |>
  left_join(options_per_q, by = "question_title",
            relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  mutate(chose_option = if_else(selection == option, 1L, 0L)) |>
  group_by(question_title, option) |>
  summarise(
    point_biserial = cor(chose_option, score, use = "complete.obs"),
    n_chose = sum(chose_option),
    is_correct_option = any(correct == 1L & chose_option == 1L),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bad_titles <- option_pbis |>
  filter(is_correct_option) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .by = question_title) |>
  filter(n > 1) |>
  pull(question_title)

option_pbis <- option_pbis |> 
  filter(!question_title %in% bad_titles)

pbis_wide <- option_pbis |>
  group_by(question_title) |>
  arrange(desc(is_correct_option), .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(
    distractor_num = cumsum(!is_correct_option),
    label = if_else(is_correct_option,
                    "point_biserial_correct",
                    paste0("point_biserial_distractor_", distractor_num)
  )) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(question_title, label, point_biserial) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = point_biserial)

### Discrimination Index ---- 
disc_index <- long |>
  filter(answered, tier %in% c("top", "bottom")) |>
  group_by(question_title, tier) |>
  summarise(p_correct = mean(correct), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tier, values_from = p_correct) |>
  mutate(discrimination_index = top - bottom) |> 
  filter(!question_title %in% bad_titles)

### Final DF ----
df <- item_stats |>
  left_join(select(disc_index, question_title, discrimination_index),
            by = "question_title") |> 
  left_join(pbis_wide, by = "question_title")

# Save ----
readr::write_excel_csv(
  df, 
  here("data", "fall" , "exam_04_combined.csv"),
  na = ""
)
```

# Selecting Questions 

## Questions to remove 
```{r}
#| output: false


print(bad_titles)
```

## Keep questions with a discrimination index greater than or equal to 0.25

From Canvas: Lower discrimination scores are scored +0.24 or lower; good scores are +0.25 or higher. 

```{r}
#| output: false


select_di <- df |> 
  filter(discrimination_index >= 0.25) |> 
  filter(if_all(c(point_biserial_distractor_1, point_biserial_distractor_2, point_biserial_distractor_3), ~ .x < 0))

select_di |> pull(question_title) |> print()
```

## Comparison of Difficulty 
```{r}
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = difficulty_index)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4C72B0", color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

mu  <- mean(df$difficulty_index, na.rm = TRUE)
sdv <- sd(df$difficulty_index, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(ggplot_build(p)$data[[1]]$count)

ggplot(df, aes(x = difficulty_index)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4C72B0", color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(difficulty_index, na.rm = TRUE)),
             color = "#C44E52", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mu + sdv),
             color = "grey30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mu - sdv),
             color = "grey30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Difficulty Index",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Frequency of revised items across the difficulty scale\n",
      "Mean = ", round(mu, 2),
      "   \u00B1 1 SD = [", round(mu - sdv, 2), ", ", round(mu + sdv, 2), "]"
    ),
    x = "Difficulty Index",
    y = "Count",
    caption = paste0("N = ", sum(!is.na(df$difficulty_index)))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

mu_di  <- mean(select_di$difficulty_index, na.rm = TRUE)
sdv_di <- sd(select_di$difficulty_index, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(select_di, aes(x = difficulty_index)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4C72B0", color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mu_di),
             color = "#C44E52", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mu_di + sdv_di),
             color = "grey30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mu_di - sdv_di),
             color = "grey30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Difficulty Index",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Frequency of revised items across the difficulty scale\n",
      "Mean = ", round(mu, 2),
      "   \u00B1 1 SD = [", round(mu - sdv, 2), ", ", round(mu + sdv, 2), "]"
    ),
    x = "Difficulty Index",
    y = "Count",
    caption = paste0("N = ", sum(!is.na(df$difficulty_index)))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
